author: reek
body: End-to-end smoke test for the propositional-equality proof layer: reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, and congruence. Each proof is a definition whose declared type is a propositional equality; the checker verifies the body against that type and the emitter erases it (CDX4020), so the program's only runtime output is the confirmation line. Successful compilation is the real assertion.

author: reek
body: These use the plain annotated-definition form, which the type checker verifies. The claim/proof/qed sugar is parsed but its claim type is not yet threaded to the proof body, so it is exercised separately as a skipped test.

author: reek
body: From a proof that a === b, cong derives f a === f b. Here Refl proves Integer === Integer, and cong lifts it under the List constructor.
